This is the original real local Gemma smoke cohort
`cio-042-accumulation-smoke-v4`, retained as a compact adversarial verifier fixture.
Archive SHA256: `793c7f34f4f5cbac4a72d2fb32b926467e22dd53a36160cd6e126a8d2b3eb55d`.
It contains 125 original files (2,368,236 uncompressed bytes), two complete real
responses, 2,320 measured model tokens, two independently failed tasks, original
DSSE payloads, public verification keys, CAS bytes and frozen source. No test
sends inference. A smoke connection result is not efficacy evidence.

No model weights, private signing/TLS keys, passwords or operator config are
included. Task data are synthetic. Code/task generators are Apache-2.0; the
installed GGUF Gemma model's own Apache-2.0 license is retained in its original
model manifest. Generated text is included for reproducibility and is not given
the package license merely because it appears in this archive. No third-party
business data or user conversations were used. Original signatures are not
regenerated. Legacy smoke accounting omitted startup RPCs from the arm action
counter; the retained originals preserve that limitation. The new capped driver
counts startup calls and does not backfill this cohort.
